q: Shor's factoring algorithm achieves exponential speedup over classical algorithms primarily using:
opts: The Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) to solve the period-finding problem on ℤ/Nℤ
exp: Shor's algorithm: reduce factoring to order-finding (find r with aʳ≡1 mod N). The QFT implements the discrete Fourier transform in O(n²) gates, finding the period r efficiently. Classical period-finding requires exponential time — the QFT gives the speedup.
